scope: Nineteen previously inspected development photographs, frozen original held-out checkpoints, no training or deployment. Partial-label metrics do not establish complete boundaries or cutting paths.

validation.archiveBrowser: pass: both languages, mobile, search, filters, pagination and preserved PDF
validation.artifactIntegrity: all recorded files and original input/source hashes verified after checks
validation.fullInverseSuite: Not rerun for offline inference and archive-only changes; no solver code changed.

visualReview.body: Higher-resolution inference claims handles, textured background and detached patches; body IoU worsens on eighteen photos. Bicycle alone improves body IoU but has no supported crop and incomplete material detail.
visualReview.material: Eight observed material errors improve, ten worsen and one is unchanged. Rabbit and outdoor checker improve interior identity yet lose crops. Blue/yellow checker retains the only 512px crop, with irregular contacts and gaps at both sizes.
visualReview.interpretation: Failure begins in the frozen learned fields before solver search. Scale affects detail and semantic context together; this does not isolate a particular layer or establish what multiscale training would do.

decision: Do not integrate 512px inference or run template fitting as an improvement: no crop gains, two crop losses, worse foreground and material averages, visible mask defects. Keep geometric production pipeline.
